settings.name: USE_BACKUP_S3
settings.description: Enable or disable the S3 backup feature

settings.name: BACKUP_S3_ROTATION
settings.description: The number of backups to keep

settings.name: BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT
settings.description: The full S3 endpoint URL, for example https://s3.example.com (https:// is added if omitted)

settings.name: BACKUP_S3_COMP_LEVEL
settings.description: Compression level of the zip uploaded to S3, from 1 (fastest) to 9 (smallest). 6 uploads the core backup unchanged.
